tieu_de: Remote - Senior UX Manager SQL, PostHog, Amplitude
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Key Responsibilities
1. UX Analytics Leadership
Own the UX Analytics team's direction, priorities, quality standards, and outcomes across product and user-experience initiatives
Translate business and product goals into clear analytical priorities, research questions, and measurable outcomes
Build and scale the team, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and capability development
Establish a data-driven UX culture where product decisions are supported by user behavior, metrics, experimentation, and market intelligence
Own the quality bar for analytical outputs, ensuring insights are accurate, actionable, and trusted across the organization
Represent UX insights, team performance, and key user-experience opportunities to senior leadership
2. Product & User Experience Analytics
Analyze user behavior, product funnels, engagement, and performance metrics to identify UX gaps and improvement opportunities
Monitor product signals and proactively identify issues before they develop into significant business or user-experience problems
Turn complex data into clear recommendations that influence product priorities, user journeys, and business decisions
Drive experimentation and continuous improvement through structured analysis, monitoring, and measurement
3. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, QA, Market, and other stakeholders to align analytical priorities with business and product objectives
Communicate analytical findings clearly and influence stakeholders to translate insights into measurable product improvements
Balance strategic team leadership with hands-on analytical problem-solving when complex or high-impact issues require deeper investigation
yeu_cau:
Product & Analytics Experience
6+ years of experience in product analytics, UX analytics, data analytics, or a related analytical function within digital products
Proven experience leading analysts and owning analytical outcomes rather than simply producing dashboards or reports
Strong proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience with product analytics platforms such as PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar tools
Strong understanding of user behavior, product funnels, experimentation, metrics, and data-driven product decision-making
Leadership & Team Building
Proven experience building or scaling an analytics team, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and developing analysts
Strong people leadership skills with the ability to set expectations, develop talent, and hold team members accountable
Comfortable balancing strategic team direction with hands-on analytical investigation when required
Business & Stakeholder Management
Strong ability to translate ambiguous business or product questions into structured analytical priorities and actionable recommendations
Clear and direct communicator who can effectively influence Product, Engineering, QA, Market, and senior leadership teams
Strong business judgment with the ability to identify what matters and make decisions based on incomplete or complex information
